titulo.alumno: Passing on a notice with «とのことだ»

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

piezas.titulo: «とのことだ» conveys information attributed to a person, institution or notice.
texto: It is common in formal and indirect communication. It attributes the content; by itself it doesn't guarantee the speaker has checked it.
かいしゃ は、 かいぎ を ごご に へんこう する との こと です。 (The company says the meeting will be moved to the afternoon.)
でんしゃ は じゅうごふん ほど おくれる との こと です。 (They report that the train will be about fifteen minutes late.)
